products.title: Products (RHP)
products.body:
- Color Powders are widely used for manufacturing products such as overhead tanks, portable sanitation units, road safety barrier automobile fuel tanks, air ducts, mudguards, toolboxes, plastic flower p
- PE Foam Compounds are widely used in the Insulated Tank and Storage Solutions industry for manufacturing rotomolded products. It finds its application in products like foam insulated water tanks, Fish
- ESF granules are widely used in intricate products like foam insulated water tanks, Fish tubs, Pallets , Plastic Refrigeration Products.
- Stone effect compound are used to manufacture molded products like: plastic planters, plastic fountains and garden furniture.
- Permanent antistatic compound are used to manufacture molded products like consumer goods for electronic application like fans, coolers, air blowers.
- Super tuff HDPE is developed for products like chemical tanks and hydraulic tanks, fuel tanks where tuff performance is required.
- It is ideal for applications such as construction site garbage chutes used in high-rise buildings, where the material must withstand the impact of heavy debris dropped from significant heights. This g
- Flame retardant compound are used to manufacture moulded products like houseware utility and petware products.
- This grade is specially used by in industrial equipments.
- Customized polyethylene-based compounds formulated using LLDPE, HDPE and specialty additives, supplied in powder or granulated form to rotational moulding manufacturers. Largest single manufactured category by revenue is Color Powders (45.55% of total sales in FY26). End-use products named: water, fuel and chemical storage tanks, portable sanitation units, furniture, industrial containers, playground equipment, pallets, fish tubs, nursery planters, road safety barriers, automobile fuel tanks, air ducts, mudguards, toolboxes, septic tanks, bio-toilets, dustbins. Company states it has 'forayed in development of nylon based compounds' and has purchased a batch of requisite raw materials, intending to commercialize them (not yet a revenue line).
- Custom moulding for companies that use roto moulded products in their final assemblies but do not mould in-house. 2.83% of total sales in FY26.
- Services aggregated to only 0.21% of total sales in FY26 (0.77% FY25, 0.25% FY24). The Rotolining service line recorded nil revenue in FY26.
- Trading rose to 7.18% of total sales in FY26 from 2.26% in FY25, driven almost entirely by the unspecified 'Other Trading' bucket (5.18% of FY26 sales vs 0.80% in FY25).

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: NOT backward integrated into polymer production. The company buys its base resins (LLDPE, HDPE) and functional additives (colour masterbatches, Plasblak, antistatic agents, flame retardants, blowing agents for foam, UV stabilizers, antioxidants) from third-party suppliers - 'primarily sourced from third party suppliers in India', with imports in fiscal 2026 from Canada, Malaysia, Thailand and UK. It holds no long-term supply contracts or fixed-price agreements with any raw material supplier and 'typically source[s] raw materials from the open market', leaving it fully exposed to polymer price volatility with no stated hedge; the single largest supplier accounted for more than 50% of purchases in each of the last three fiscals (62.60% / 64.57% / 61.30%). Restated financials break raw materials consumed into Granules 3,858.35 lakhs, Master Batch 330.08 lakhs and Chemical 94.03 lakhs for FY26 - the dominant input is bought-in polymer granules. Within its own gate the company is integrated across the compound process chain: raw material selection, weighing/batching, compounding (twin-screw or single-screw extrusion) or dry blending, cooling and pelletizing, grinding/pulverizing to a 20-35 mesh target, in-house testing and quality control (MFI, particle size, colour consistency) and packing in 25 kg woven bags - all at one site with its own laboratory and QC department. It is PARTIALLY FORWARD integrated one step past the compound: it also moulds finished custom moulded tanks (water, fuel, chemical) on three rotational moulding machines, and sells rotolining and toll pulverising job-work services to the same industry it supplies compounds to. On the sales side it states it 'sell[s] directly to majority of our customers' in a B2B model (the document does not describe the channel for the remaining minority, and no distribution or agency network of its own is disclosed), while simultaneously acting as the inbound all-India distributor for four foreign principals (Lysis Technologies UK, Axel Plastics USA, 493K Ltd Northern Ireland, Salee Colour Plc Thailand), which is a lateral trading extension rather than integration. Utilities are partly captive: 177 kWp rooftop solar supplements Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Co. Ltd. grid supply, water comes from an on-site borewell, and the plant is a zero liquid discharge facility with cooling towers and an RO system. The site itself is LEASED, not owned. The company states it has no collaborations, tie-ups or joint ventures other than in the normal course of business.

demand_drivers.title: Seasonality (RHP report)
demand_drivers.body: The RHP gives NO quantified or substantive seasonality disclosure, and its own cross-reference is circular. Under 'Other Regulatory and Statutory Disclosures' the item '7. Seasonality of business' reads verbatim: 'For Seasonality of business, see "Industry Overview" and "Our Business" on pages 96 and 107, respectively of this Red Herring Prospectus.' Neither of those chapters contains a seasonality discussion; the only seasonality statement anywhere in the 328-page document is the single clause in Our Business: 'our diversified product portfolio helps counter seasonal trends and addresses different business cycles across industries where our products are used.' The only other occurrence of the word in the document is 'seasonally adjusted HSBC India Manufacturing PMI' in the Industry Overview, which describes the Indian economy and not the issuer. No quarterly, half-yearly or month-wise revenue or production split is presented anywhere.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Our business is dependent and will continue to depend on our manufacturing facility, and we are subject to certain risks in our manufacturing process.
- Any slowdown or shutdown in our manufacturing operations or strikes, work stoppages or increased wage demands by our employees that could interfere with our operations could have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations.
- We operate from our manufacturing facility situated at Khatwad Tal, Dindori Dist, Nashik, Maharashtra which is spread across approximately 5100 sq. mts.
- The core of our business relies on efficient management of the manufacturing facility, however our operations face several operational risks, some of which are beyond our control, such as the breakdown, failure of equipment or industrial accidents, severe weather conditions and natural disasters.
- Further, we may be subject to manufacturing disruptions due to contraventions by us of any of the conditions of our regulatory approvals, which may require our manufacturing facilities to cease, or limit, production until the disputes concerning such approvals are resolved.
- While we have not encountered significant disruptions at our manufacturing facilities in recent years, we did experience a decline in production during 2020 due to the challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic.
- While we have since recovered, we cannot guarantee that future disruptions will not occur.
- Our inability to effectively respond to such events and rectify any disruption, in a timely manner and at an acceptable cost, could lead to the slowdown or shutdown of our operations or the under-utilization of our manufacturing facilities, which in turn may have an adverse effect on our business, financial condition and results of operations. 2.
